meta.title: Price and volume in stock-market trading
meta.description: An interactive, evidence-first guide to auctions, trade prints, relative volume, price-volume quadrants, follow-through, absorption, divergence, and context.

ui.waiting: The visual will load when it enters the viewport.
ui.error: The visual could not be displayed. Read the explanation above instead.
ui.figureFallback: Enable JavaScript to explore this synthetic-data experiment. Price and volume are contextual evidence, not trading instructions.

hero.title: Price shows where an auction moved. Volume shows how much traded there.
hero.subtitle: Learn to read the two together as evidence about participation, liquidity, and price behavior—not as a certain signal. All sequences are synthetic, for education only, and not investment advice.

overview.title: Every print begins with a matched auction
body: A market is a continuous auction. Buyers advertise bids, sellers advertise asks, and a trade prints only when compatible orders meet. Price records the level of that agreement; volume records the quantity exchanged.
The same reported volume can accompany very different outcomes. Available liquidity, urgency, news, time of day, and the surrounding trend all affect how far price travels.

plainLanguage.label: Plainly
plainLanguage.body: Price is the location of agreement. Volume is the amount of agreement. Neither reveals motive by itself.

keyPoints.title: Auction
keyPoints.body: Orders compete for limited liquidity at different prices.

keyPoints.title: Print
keyPoints.body: One execution contributes both a price and a quantity.

keyPoints.title: Context
keyPoints.body: Interpretation changes with baseline, location, and what happens next.

overview.demoTitle: Hold synthetic execution volume constant and change liquidity depth

copy.ariaLabel: Interactive synthetic order-book comparison showing the same execution volume producing different price displacement in thick and thin liquidity

scenarios.label: Thick liquidity
scenarios.bookAria: Thick synthetic order book with substantial displayed size at three bid and ask levels
scenarios.status: Same synthetic execution volume, different displacement: 900 units meet thick displayed liquidity and move price by only +0.18. Equal volume does not mean equal price displacement.

scenarios.label: Thin liquidity
scenarios.bookAria: Thin synthetic order book with limited displayed size at three bid and ask levels
scenarios.status: Same synthetic execution volume, different displacement: 900 units consume more levels in thin displayed liquidity and move price by +0.92. Equal volume does not mean equal price displacement.

scenarios.label: Balanced reference
scenarios.bookAria: Balanced synthetic order book with moderate displayed size at three bid and ask levels
scenarios.status: The balanced synthetic reference keeps execution volume at 900 units and produces +0.36 displacement. The contrast still depends on displayed depth, not volume alone.

copy.syntheticNote: All order-book depth, execution volume, and price displacement values are synthetic and educational—not live data, a forecast, recommendation, or investment advice.

steps.title: Volume counts completed transfers, not conviction
body: Every completed trade has both a buyer and a seller. A 10,000-share print is 10,000 shares of volume—not 20,000—and it does not prove that either side is informed.
What analysts casually call buying or selling pressure usually describes which side crossed the spread or how price responded to executions. Reported volume alone does not identify intent.

plainLanguage.label: Plainly
plainLanguage.body: Volume tells you how much changed hands. The path of price helps describe how the auction handled that activity.

keyPoints.title: One transfer
keyPoints.body: Each execution pairs a buyer with a seller.

keyPoints.title: Aggressor is partial evidence
keyPoints.body: Crossing the spread shows immediacy, not future correctness.

keyPoints.title: Response matters
keyPoints.body: Large activity with small travel differs from large activity with easy travel.

steps.demoTitle: Compare synthetic trade-size and price-response sequences

copy.ariaLabel: Interactive synthetic trade tape comparing similar volume with different price responses
copy.chartLabel: Five synthetic trade groups with price labels and volume bars

scenarios.label: More travel
scenarios.status: Synthetic sequence: activity is accompanied by progressively higher transaction prices. This describes price response, not a guaranteed continuation.

scenarios.label: Less travel
scenarios.status: Synthetic sequence: comparable activity produces little net movement. Liquidity may be absorbing flow, but motive and next direction remain unknown.

copy.syntheticNote: All prices and volumes are synthetic. The experiment is educational and does not provide a trading signal or investment advice.

steps.title: Volume becomes informative only against a relevant baseline
body: A million shares can be exceptional for one stock and routine for another. Relative volume compares current activity with a chosen norm, ideally controlling for the instrument and time of day.
The baseline is a modeling choice. A quiet holiday, index rebalance, opening auction, earnings release, or data error can distort the comparison.

plainLanguage.label: Plainly
plainLanguage.body: Ask “high compared with what?” before calling volume unusual.

keyPoints.title: Same instrument
keyPoints.body: Liquidity differs dramatically across securities.

keyPoints.title: Comparable clock
keyPoints.body: Intraday volume usually has a strong time-of-day pattern.

keyPoints.title: Known events
keyPoints.body: Scheduled and structural flows can change the baseline.

steps.demoTitle: Adjust one synthetic session against a baseline

copy.ariaLabel: Interactive synthetic relative-volume calculator with opening, midday, and closing time-of-day baselines
copy.chartAriaTemplate: Synthetic {period} baseline {baseline} units compared with current volume {current} units, giving relative volume {ratio} times
copy.statusTemplate: Current synthetic volume is {current} units. Against the {period} synthetic baseline of {baseline}, relative volume is {ratio}×. The same absolute amount changes meaning when the selected baseline changes; no universal threshold is implied.
copy.syntheticNote: Every volume and baseline value is synthetic. The comparison is educational, uses no universal threshold, and is not investment advice.

steps.title: Four quadrants organize observations—not predictions
body: Combining price direction with relative-volume direction creates four descriptive quadrants. They help formulate questions about participation and ease of movement.
A quadrant is not a rule such as “high volume means up.” The same quadrant can appear at trend beginnings, trend endings, noisy ranges, or event-driven gaps.

plainLanguage.label: Plainly
plainLanguage.body: Use the quadrant to name what happened, then investigate why and whether it persists.

keyPoints.title: Direction
keyPoints.body: Arrows and words encode price direction; color is supplementary.

keyPoints.title: Participation
keyPoints.body: Patterned volume cues show rising or falling activity.

keyPoints.title: Uncertainty
keyPoints.body: Each quadrant supports multiple explanations.

copy.ariaLabel: Interactive four-quadrant matrix for price direction and relative-volume direction

quadrants.title: Price ↑ · volume ↑
quadrants.status: Participation expanded as price rose. Possible explanations include broad demand, short covering, event repricing, or churn. Follow-through and location decide what the evidence means.

quadrants.title: Price ↑ · volume ↓
quadrants.status: Price rose on lighter activity. The path may reflect thin supply, a quiet drift, or weakening participation; none is certain without liquidity and follow-through evidence.

quadrants.title: Price ↓ · volume ↑
quadrants.status: Participation expanded as price fell. This may reflect urgent selling, forced flow, repricing, or responsive demand meeting supply. It does not guarantee further decline.

quadrants.title: Price ↓ · volume ↓
quadrants.status: Price fell on lighter activity. This can be a quiet pullback, weak demand, or thin liquidity. It is descriptive—not proof of reversal or continuation.

copy.syntheticNote: Conceptual quadrants using synthetic conditions. No quadrant is a buy or sell instruction.

steps.title: A level crossing is an event; follow-through is the test
body: A breakout is simply price moving beyond a chosen reference. Elevated relative volume can show that more participation accompanied the crossing, but it cannot guarantee acceptance beyond the level.
Inspect subsequent closes, retests, range expansion, liquidity, and the time horizon. This synthetic experiment is educational only and must not be used as a trade trigger.

plainLanguage.label: Plainly
plainLanguage.body: Do not stop the film on the crossing bar. Ask what the auction does next.

keyPoints.title: Define the level
keyPoints.body: Reference levels are analytical choices, not natural laws.

keyPoints.title: Observe acceptance
keyPoints.body: Repeated trade beyond a level differs from a brief excursion.

keyPoints.title: Check follow-through
keyPoints.body: Later behavior can strengthen, weaken, or invalidate the initial interpretation.

steps.demoTitle: Change the observation window after a synthetic crossing

copy.ariaLabel: Interactive comparison of two synthetic high-relative-volume crossings with different later outcomes

windows.label: Crossing only
windows.status: At the crossing, both synthetic paths look similar and both have high relative volume. The outcome cannot be known at this point; this evidence is not a trading trigger.

windows.label: Follow-through
windows.status: Only later evidence distinguishes the paths: Path A shows acceptance above the broken area, while Path B quickly returns to the range. This retrospective distinction is not a trading trigger or investment advice.

aria.crossing: Synthetic path A through the high-relative-volume crossing only; later outcome is hidden and undetermined
aria.followThrough: Synthetic path A with follow-through, showing later acceptance above the broken area

aria.crossing: Synthetic path B through the high-relative-volume crossing only; later outcome is hidden and undetermined
aria.followThrough: Synthetic path B with follow-through, showing a quick rejection back into the prior range

copy.syntheticNote: Both paths, prices, and relative-volume observations are synthetic and educational. They are not forecasts, recommendations, trading triggers, or investment advice.

steps.title: Effort and result can diverge without revealing the next move
body: Absorption describes substantial execution meeting enough opposing liquidity that price travels less than expected. Divergence describes price and a chosen volume measure behaving differently across observations.

Both are hypotheses, not direct observations of hidden intent. Absorption can persist or fail; divergence can resolve through price, volume, time, or a changed baseline. It does not guarantee reversal.

plainLanguage.label: Plainly
plainLanguage.body: A lot of effort with little movement is worth investigating, not automatically trading.

keyPoints.title: Observe
keyPoints.body: Measure price travel, executed volume, spread, and time.

keyPoints.title: Hypothesize
keyPoints.body: Liquidity may be absorbing flow, but identities and motives remain uncertain.

keyPoints.title: Seek confirmation
keyPoints.body: Later behavior can support or reject the hypothesis.

copy.ariaLabel: Interactive synthetic comparison of absorption, divergence, and ordinary movement

patterns.label: Possible absorption
patterns.status: Synthetic observation: activity rises while price remains compressed. Absorption is one hypothesis; hidden orders, two-way churn, or the selected scale may also explain it.

patterns.label: Divergence
patterns.status: Synthetic observation: price advances while relative activity fades. This does not imply an imminent reversal; liquidity and baseline choices can produce the same shape.

patterns.label: Co-movement
patterns.status: Synthetic observation: price travel and activity expand together. It describes participation, not future return or durability.

copy.syntheticNote: Synthetic dots only. “Absorption” and “divergence” are conditional interpretations, not certain signals.

steps.title: Finish with a context checklist, not a trading command
body: A disciplined reading documents the instrument, session, horizon, baseline, event calendar, liquidity regime, market backdrop, and follow-through. Missing context should lower confidence rather than invite a stronger story.

Price-volume analysis can organize questions about participation, liquidity, and price behavior. It cannot determine fair value, predict returns, or replace independent research and professional advice.

plainLanguage.label: Plainly
plainLanguage.body: The output is a qualified observation with known limits—not buy, sell, sizing, or return guidance.

keyPoints.title: Normalize
keyPoints.body: Choose a defensible comparison for instrument and time.

keyPoints.title: Locate
keyPoints.body: Place the observation inside trend, range, event, and liquidity context.

keyPoints.title: Recheck
keyPoints.body: Define what later evidence would change the interpretation.

copy.ariaLabel: Seven-item interactive context checklist for a synthetic price-volume observation

items.title: Relevant baseline
items.body: Compare like with like, including instrument and time-of-day seasonality.

items.title: Structural location
items.body: Record trend, range, reference levels, gaps, and the observation horizon.

items.title: Volatility and liquidity
items.body: Inspect volatility, spread, displayed depth, and known structural flow.

items.title: News and scheduled flow
items.body: Check news, earnings, auctions, and index adjustments that may change participation.

items.title: Closing location
items.body: Document where the interval closed relative to its range and reference area.

items.title: Later acceptance, rejection, or reversal
items.body: Observe which later behavior supports, weakens, or contradicts the initial hypothesis.

items.title: Data-source representativeness
items.body: Ask which venue, feed, aggregation, and missing activity the data represents.

copy.educationNote: Educational framework only. The output is an evidence-quality note—not investment advice, a buy or sell instruction, position sizing, or return guidance.

closing.title: Read participation, liquidity, and response as a chain of conditional evidence
body: Start with the auction, normalize activity, describe the price-volume quadrant, then observe follow-through. Separate measurements from interpretations such as absorption or divergence.
This visual is for education only and is not investment advice. Price and volume do not guarantee direction, returns, or a successful decision.
checklist: What exactly traded, where, and over what interval?
How far did price travel for the activity observed?
Where is the observation in the broader structure?
What happened after the initial event?
What evidence would invalidate the interpretation?

scaleItems.question: What executed?
scaleItems.role: Price and quantity at the transaction level.

scaleItems.question: What changed?
scaleItems.role: Relative activity and price response across a chosen window.

scaleItems.question: What could explain it?
scaleItems.role: Liquidity, events, structure, baseline, and subsequent evidence.

closing.finalQuote: Volume can make an observation more consequential; it cannot make an interpretation certain.
closing.sourceNote: All numerical sequences in this explainer are synthetic. Educational use only; not investment advice.

meta.title: 股市交易原理：量价关系
meta.description: 从连续竞价、成交机制、相对成交量、量价四象限、突破跟随、吸收与背离，到上下文清单的交互图解。

ui.waiting: 图解将在进入视口后加载。
ui.error: 图解暂时无法显示，请阅读上方文字说明。
ui.figureFallback: 启用 JavaScript 后可操作合成数据实验。量价只是上下文证据，不是交易指令。

hero.eyebrow: 市场微观结构 / 上下文，而非确定性
hero.title: 价格显示竞价走到哪里，成交量显示在那里交换了多少
hero.subtitle: 把两者结合起来，理解参与度、流动性与价格行为的上下文证据，而不是寻找确定信号。全部序列均为合成数据，仅供教育，不构成投资建议。

overview.title: 每一笔成交，都始于买卖订单的匹配
body: 市场是一场连续竞价。买方挂出买价，卖方挂出卖价，只有兼容订单相遇时才会成交。价格记录达成交易的位置，成交量记录交换的数量。
相同成交量可能对应完全不同的价格结果。可用流动性、紧迫程度、消息、时段和既有结构，都会影响价格走多远。

plainLanguage.label: 说白了
plainLanguage.body: 价格是成交位置，成交量是成交数量；两者都不能单独揭示交易动机。

keyPoints.title: 竞价
keyPoints.body: 订单在不同价位争夺有限流动性。

keyPoints.title: 成交
keyPoints.body: 每次执行同时产生价格和数量。

keyPoints.title: 上下文
keyPoints.body: 基准、位置与后续行为会改变解释。

overview.demoTitle: 保持合成执行量不变，只切换流动性深度

copy.ariaLabel: 比较同一合成执行量在厚流动性与薄流动性中产生不同价格位移的交互订单簿
copy.controlLabel: 选择一种合成流动性状态

scenarios.label: 厚流动性
scenarios.bookAria: 三档买卖价位均有较多展示数量的厚合成订单簿
scenarios.status: 同一合成执行量，不同价格位移：900 单位遇到较厚的展示流动性，只产生 +0.18 位移。同量不等于同位移。

scenarios.label: 薄流动性
scenarios.bookAria: 三档买卖价位展示数量均有限的薄合成订单簿
scenarios.status: 同一合成执行量，不同价格位移：900 单位在较薄的展示流动性中消耗更多档位，产生 +0.92 位移。同量不等于同位移。

scenarios.label: 平衡参考
scenarios.bookAria: 三档买卖价位展示数量适中的平衡合成订单簿
scenarios.status: 平衡合成参考仍把执行量固定在 900 单位，并产生 +0.36 位移；差异来自展示深度，而不是成交量本身。

copy.syntheticNote: 订单簿深度、执行量和价格位移均为合成数据，仅供教育；不是实时行情、预测、推荐或投资建议。

steps.title: 成交量统计已完成的交换，不统计“信念”
body: 每笔成交同时有买方和卖方。10,000 股成交只计 10,000 股成交量，而不是 20,000 股；它也不能证明任何一方掌握更多信息。
人们口中的买压或卖压，通常在描述谁主动跨过价差，或价格如何响应成交。单看成交量无法辨认意图。

plainLanguage.label: 说白了
plainLanguage.body: 成交量告诉你换手多少；价格路径告诉你竞价如何消化这些活动。

keyPoints.title: 一次转移
keyPoints.body: 每次执行都配对一位买方和一位卖方。

keyPoints.title: 主动方只是部分证据
keyPoints.body: 跨过价差代表即时性，不代表未来判断正确。

keyPoints.title: 响应很重要
keyPoints.body: 大量活动、位移很小，与大量活动、轻松位移并不相同。

steps.demoTitle: 对比相似成交量下的合成价格响应

copy.ariaLabel: 比较相近成交量但不同价格响应的合成交带交互图
copy.chartLabel: 五组合成成交及其价格标签与成交量柱

scenarios.label: 位移较大
scenarios.status: 合成序列：活动伴随成交价逐步抬高。这描述价格响应，不保证后续延续。

scenarios.label: 位移较小
scenarios.status: 合成序列：相近活动只产生很小净位移。流动性可能在吸收流量，但动机和下一方向仍未知。

copy.syntheticNote: 全部价格与成交量均为合成数据。实验仅供教育，不提供交易信号或投资建议。

steps.title: 成交量只有相对于合适基准才有信息量
body: 一百万股对一只股票可能异常，对另一只却很平常。相对成交量把当前活动与选定常态比较，最好同时控制标的与日内时段。
基准本身是一种建模选择。清淡节假日、指数调仓、开盘集合竞价、财报或数据错误，都可能扭曲比较。

plainLanguage.label: 说白了
plainLanguage.body: 在说成交量异常前，先问“相对什么而言？”

keyPoints.title: 同一标的
keyPoints.body: 不同证券的流动性差异巨大。

keyPoints.title: 可比时钟
keyPoints.body: 日内成交量通常有明显时段季节性。

keyPoints.title: 已知事件
keyPoints.body: 计划性与结构性流量会改变基准。

steps.demoTitle: 把一个合成时段与基准比较

copy.ariaLabel: 可切换开盘附近、午间和收盘附近基准的合成相对成交量计算器
copy.chartAriaTemplate: {period}合成基准为 {baseline} 单位，当前成交量为 {current} 单位，相对成交量为 {ratio} 倍
copy.periodControlLabel: 选择合成日内时段基准
copy.statusTemplate: 当前合成成交量为 {current} 单位。相对于{period}的 {baseline} 单位合成基准，相对成交量为 {ratio} 倍。同一绝对量会随所选基准改变含义，这里不暗示任何通用阈值。
copy.syntheticNote: 全部成交量与基准均为合成数据。本比较仅供教育，不采用通用阈值，也不构成投资建议。

steps.title: 量价四象限用于组织观察，不用于预测
body: 把价格方向与相对成交量方向组合，可得到四个描述性象限。它们帮助提出有关参与度和位移难易的问题。
象限不是“放量就涨”之类规则。同一象限可出现在趋势初期、末期、震荡区间或事件跳空中。

plainLanguage.label: 说白了
plainLanguage.body: 先用象限说清发生了什么，再调查原因和是否持续。

keyPoints.title: 方向
keyPoints.body: 用箭头和文字编码价格方向，颜色只是辅助。

keyPoints.title: 参与度
keyPoints.body: 用带纹理的成交量提示活动增减。

keyPoints.title: 不确定性
keyPoints.body: 每个象限都支持多种解释。

steps.demoTitle: 逐一审问四个描述性象限

copy.ariaLabel: 价格方向与相对成交量方向的交互四象限矩阵

quadrants.title: 价 ↑ · 量 ↑
quadrants.axes: 价格更高 / 相对活动更高
quadrants.status: 价格上升同时参与扩大。可能解释包括广泛需求、空头回补、事件重估或双向换手；后续与位置决定证据意义。

quadrants.title: 价 ↑ · 量 ↓
quadrants.axes: 价格更高 / 相对活动更低
quadrants.status: 价格在较轻活动中上升。可能是供给稀薄、安静漂移或参与减弱；缺少流动性和后续证据时都不确定。

quadrants.title: 价 ↓ · 量 ↑
quadrants.axes: 价格更低 / 相对活动更高
quadrants.status: 价格下跌同时参与扩大。可能是紧急卖出、被动流量、重估或承接需求；不保证继续下跌。

quadrants.title: 价 ↓ · 量 ↓
quadrants.axes: 价格更低 / 相对活动更低
quadrants.status: 价格在较轻活动中下跌。可能是安静回撤、需求不足或流动性稀薄；它只是描述，不证明反转或延续。

copy.syntheticNote: 四象限使用合成条件进行概念说明。任何象限都不是买卖指令。

steps.title: 越过价位只是事件，后续跟随才是检验
body: 突破只是价格越过所选参考位。相对成交量升高可说明更多参与伴随越位，但不能保证价格会在参考位之外被接受。
应继续观察后续收盘、回测、区间扩张、流动性与时间尺度。本合成实验仅供教育，不能作为交易触发器。

plainLanguage.label: 说白了
plainLanguage.body: 不要把电影停在越位那根柱上，要看竞价接下来怎么走。

keyPoints.title: 定义价位
keyPoints.body: 参考位是分析选择，不是自然法则。

keyPoints.title: 观察接受
keyPoints.body: 反复在价位外成交，不同于短暂刺穿。

keyPoints.title: 检查跟随
keyPoints.body: 后续行为可增强、削弱或否定初始解释。

steps.demoTitle: 改变合成越位后的观察窗口

copy.ariaLabel: 比较两段突破当日相似、相对成交量都较高但后续不同的合成路径

windows.label: 仅看越位
windows.status: 越位当下，两条合成路径形态相似，相对成交量都较高；此时无法预知结果，也不能把这些证据当作交易触发器。

windows.label: 观察后续
windows.status: 只有后续证据才能区分：路径 A 显示在被突破区上方接受，路径 B 则快速回到区间。这种事后区分不构成交易触发器或投资建议。

aria.crossing: 合成路径 A 只显示高相对成交量越位，隐藏后续，结果尚无法判断
aria.followThrough: 合成路径 A 显示后续，并在被突破区上方获得接受

aria.crossing: 合成路径 B 只显示高相对成交量越位，隐藏后续，结果尚无法判断
aria.followThrough: 合成路径 B 显示后续，并快速拒绝回到原区间

copy.syntheticNote: 两条路径、价格与相对成交量均为合成数据，仅供教育；不是预测、推荐、交易触发器或投资建议。

steps.title: 努力与结果可以背离，却不能泄露下一步
body: 吸收描述大量成交遇到足够反向流动性，使价格位移小于预期。背离描述价格与所选成交量指标在多次观察中走向不同。
两者都是假设，不是隐藏意图的直接观测。吸收可能延续也可能失效；背离可通过价格、成交量、时间或基准改变而化解，绝不意味着必然反转。

plainLanguage.label: 说白了
plainLanguage.body: 努力很多、位移很小值得调查，但不能自动下单。

keyPoints.title: 观察
keyPoints.body: 测量价格位移、成交量、价差和时间。

keyPoints.title: 提出假设
keyPoints.body: 流动性可能吸收流量，但身份和动机未知。

keyPoints.title: 寻找确认
keyPoints.body: 后续行为可支持或拒绝假设。

steps.demoTitle: 比较合成的努力—结果模式

patterns.status: 合成观察：价格推进而相对活动下降。这不意味着马上反转；流动性和基准选择也可产生同样形状。

steps.title: 用上下文清单收尾，而不是输出交易命令
body: 严谨解读应记录标的、时段、尺度、基准、事件日历、流动性环境、大盘背景与后续跟随。缺失上下文应降低信心，而不是催生更强故事。
量价分析可以组织有关参与度、流动性与价格行为的问题；它不能确定公允价值、预测收益，也不能替代独立研究和专业意见。

同じ出来高でも価格結果は異なります。利用可能な流動性、緊急度、ニュース、時間帯、周囲の構造が値幅を左右します。

買い圧力・売り圧力という表現は、誰がスプレッドを越えたか、または価格が執行にどう反応したかを指すことが多く、出来高だけでは意図を識別できません。

closing.title: 参加度・流動性・反応を条件付き証拠の連鎖として読む
body: オークションから始め、活動を正規化し、四象限を記述して追随を観察します。測定と吸収・乖離などの解釈を分けます。
本図解は教育目的のみで、投資助言ではありません。価格と出来高は方向、収益、意思決定成功を保証しません。
checklist: 何が、どこで、どの時間軸で取引されたか？
相対出来高はどう正規化されたか？
観察活動に対して価格はどれほど移動したか？
観察は大きな構造のどこにあるか？
初期イベント後に何が起きたか？
どの証拠が現在解釈を無効にするか？

scaleItems.question: 何が執行された？
scaleItems.role: 取引水準の価格と数量。

scaleItems.question: 何が変化した？
scaleItems.role: 選択窓内の相対活動と価格反応。

scaleItems.question: 何が説明できる？
scaleItems.role: 流動性、イベント、構造、基準、後続証拠。

closing.finalQuote: 出来高は観察を重要にできますが、解釈を確実にはできません。
closing.sourceNote: 本図解の数値系列はすべて合成です。教育目的のみで、投資助言ではありません。
